source.author: Quaternius
source.note: Wave-1 row 66 asked for a woman in a dress (row 72 Animated Woman is the poly.pizza Quaternius model, behind a Cloudflare challenge). The Quaternius Ultimate Animated Character Pack (Nov 2019, OpenGameArt) used by man-casual and woman-casual has no everyday dress or skirt: its only dress is on Witch, whose pointed hat is part of the same single mesh and cannot be dropped. Substituted with Casual3_Female (tank top, cropped trousers, long loose hair): same pack, rig, clips and scale as the two casual characters, so the three read as one cast.
